dynamic:
# Generated by `edge up` — edit config, not this file.
http:
  routers:
    to-https:
      entryPoints:
        - web
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      priority: 1
      middlewares:
        - to-https
      service: noop@internal
    dashboard:
      entryPoints:
        - websecure
      rule: Host(`edge.acme.localhost`) || Host(`edge.acme.internal`)
      service: api@internal
      tls: {}
    route-api-shop:
      entryPoints:
        - websecure
      rule: Host(`api.shop.acme.localhost`) || Host(`api.shop.acme.internal`)
      service: route-api-shop
      tls: {}
    route-app-shop:
      entryPoints:
        - websecure
      rule: Host(`app.shop.acme.localhost`) || Host(`app.shop.acme.internal`)
      service: route-app-shop
      tls: {}
    route-app-webapp:
      entryPoints:
        - websecure
      rule: Host(`app.webapp.acme.localhost`) || Host(`app.webapp.acme.internal`)
      service: route-app-webapp
      tls: {}
    route-den:
      entryPoints:
        - websecure
      rule: Host(`den.acme.localhost`) || Host(`den.acme.internal`)
      service: route-den
      tls: {}
  middlewares:
    to-https:
      redirectScheme:
        scheme: https
        permanent: false
  services:
    route-api-shop:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://host.docker.internal:3001
    route-app-shop:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://host.docker.internal:5173
    route-app-webapp:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://webapp:3000
    route-den:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://host.docker.internal:7791
tls:
  stores:
    default:
      defaultCertificate: &a1
        certFile: /etc/edge/certs/edge.pem
        keyFile: /etc/edge/certs/edge-key.pem
  certificates:
    - *a1
compose:
name: acme-edge
services:
  edge:
    image: traefik:v3.7
    container_name: acme-edge
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - --entrypoints.web.address=:80
      - --entrypoints.websecure.address=:443
      - --providers.file.directory=/etc/edge/dynamic
      - --providers.file.watch=true
      - --api.dashboard=true
      - --ping=true
      - --log.level=WARN
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    volumes:
      - ./dynamic:/etc/edge/dynamic:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/edge/certs:ro
    networks:
      - acme-edge
networks:
  acme-edge:
    external: true
